overview:
"Customer Value" Meeting Room
2 x new Samsing 55" commercial displays to be wall mounted using the appropriate tilting wall mount from Chief.
Video conferencing to be supported by the HP/Poly Studio X52 all-in-one video bar, to be wall mounted centrally underneath the
displays using the HP/Poly wall mount.
The HP/Poly TC10 touch panel controller to be presented on the meeting room table for users to quickly and easily join MS Teams
meetings.
**Client to provide the correct Microsoft Teams Meeting Licence to the 21st Century AV Operations Team prior to installation to allow
seamless setup and configuration of the system.

"Great People" Meeting Room
2 x new Samsing 55" commercial displays to be wall mounted using the appropriate tilting wall mount from Chief.
Video conferencing to be supported by the HP/Poly Studio X52 all-in-one video bar, to be wall mounted centrally underneath the
displays using the HP/Poly wall mount.
The HP/Poly TC10 touch panel controller to be presented on the meeting room table for users to quickly and easily join MS Teams
meetings.
**Client to provide the correct Microsoft Teams Meeting Licence to the 21st Century AV Operations Team prior to installation to allow
seamless setup and configuration of the system.

Professional Services
If purchased, the Technical Site Survey will confirm installation of the hardware is suitable for the room, confirm cable routes and
pathways.
Installation will be carried out by qualified Audio Visual Engineers in work hours 9am to 5.30pm.
Rubbish removal will be the responsibility of the client unless previously agreed.
A revised proposal may be necessary after the technical site survey has been completed.
Please ensure all Power and Network requirements are in place with any hardware licences purchased prior to installation.
(Failure to have these item in place prior to installation may result in a failed installation and a chageable return visit.)

Support Services
Our 1-Year Support Plan ensures the reliability and performance of your supplied audio-visual hardware with a full suite of
maintenance and assistance services.

Summary
Thank you for considering 21st Century AV for your audio-visual installation. We are pleased to present the above detailed quotation,
carefully tailored to meet your requirements and ensure a high-quality setup.
Important Considerations.
All quoted prices are subject to a full technical site survey.
The client or designated third party must ensure the availability of required power and network points prior to installation.
Any modifications to the design, specifications, or pricing must be agreed upon with the client before installation proceeds.
If you require any further clarification or adjustments, please do not hesitate to reach out. We look forward to assisting you with this
project.
